questions.input: Write a Python function dedupe(items) that returns a new list with duplicate values removed while preserving first-seen order. Assume every item is hashable.
questions.grading: A correct answer must return unique hashable items in first-seen order without modifying the input list.

questions.input: Extract the meeting details into exactly this JSON shape: {"date":"YYYY-MM-DD","time":"HH:MM","timezone":"string","attendees":["string"],"topic":"string"}. Text: Priya and Mateo will meet on 2026-09-03 at 14:30 Eastern Time to review the Atlas migration plan.
questions.grading: A correct answer must be valid JSON with exactly the requested keys and all five details accurately extracted.
